script.text: Beside the bus shelter, where a torn schedule flapped in the wind, a hand-painted sign advertised piano lessons for the whole block,‖

I peeled off a second tab just in case.‖

script.text: Near the harbor terminal, the ramp began to lift toward the dock,‖
A deckhand shouted 快点上船 just as the ramp began to lift.
and two latecomers sprinted the last few meters to make it.‖
A crate of fish sat half-covered by a torn tarp.‖
The engine groaned once before settling into a steady rhythm.‖
I held the railing the whole way across the channel.‖
Another worker checked tickets near the far gate.‖
The line moved steadily despite the narrow ramp.‖
I found a seat near the back before the horn sounded.‖

script.text: Right outside the corner store, two men set up a folding table for chess every afternoon,‖
and a small crowd of onlookrs
onlookers usually gathers by the second game.‖
